subject: 朝阳北塔 · 方形十三层密檐塔南面全貌
name: 朝阳北塔
yearNote: “五世同体”：三燕宫殿夯土台基、北魏“思燕佛图”台基、隋唐方塔内核、辽塔外表；现存外观为辽初与重熙十三年（1044）两度维修后的面貌（辽宁文旅）。年份取1044年辽代重修作约略定位，不代表始建；1984—1992年修缮并发现天宫、地宫，塔顶宝盖为修复件。
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q11092604（朝阳北塔 Northern Chaoyang Pagoda）P625 坐标 41.57888889, 120.45638889，塔体近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点复用既有 chaoyang。
lede: 北魏思燕佛图的台基上，隋唐方塔被辽代砖塔整个包在里面，朝阳北塔因此被称为“塔包塔”的五世同体之塔。现存外观是辽重熙十三年（1044）维修后的面貌：方形塔身四面各雕一尊坐佛与胁侍、灵塔、飞天，其上十三层叠涩密檐收成挺拔的锥形，高四十二米余。
facts: 年代：北魏“思燕佛图”台基上包着隋唐砖塔，辽初与重熙十三年（1044）两度维修并更名延昌寺塔；1984—1992年修缮时发现地宫、中宫与天宫。1988年列第三批国保。
形制：方形空心十三级叠涩密檐式砖塔，现高42.6米；塔身四面各以一尊坐佛居中，旁为胁侍菩萨，外置灵塔，合为密宗金刚界四方佛、八胁侍、八大灵塔与二十四飞天。
图版：以2015年南面实拍为主，十三重檐经目视与灰度剖面两种方法逐檐计数核对（一层宽檐带斗栱加其上十二层）；塔前围栏、灯柱与游人去除，塔顶现存绿琉璃宝盖按实拍保留。
caption: 朝阳北塔 · 方形十三层密檐
辽 · 1044重修
structure_checkpoints: 台基：方形砖砌须弥座式基座，上有一圈仿木栏板（照片下缘），基座正面中央一道台阶；基座前的现代地面与围栏不画。
塔身：高大的方形第一层塔身，正面正中一尊结跏趺坐佛（圆形头光与背光），两侧各一胁侍菩萨，两外侧各一座小型灵塔浮雕，上部一排飞天与宝盖；塔身四角有角柱。
第一层檐：塔身顶部一圈砖雕斗栱（正面可数约九攒），承托最宽的第一层檐。
密檐：第一层檐以上十二层叠涩檐逐层收窄，合计十三重檐。2015年实拍（3264×4912）检查：上半段裁图（行1149—1965）目视数到7层，下半段裁图（行1891—2726）接续数到第13层（宽檐）；中轴灰度剖面在行1424—3095检出11道檐影，加上裁图起点以上的2道，同为13。上一轮三稿檐数分别为14、12、12，均未通过。
塔顶：十三层檐上为平顶，中央一座绿琉璃覆钵状宝盖（现状修复件），顶出细刹杆；四角有细拉索（不画）。
material_observations: 塔身与檐为青灰色砖，檐面覆灰筒瓦、檐端有瓦当滴水；塔身浮雕砖雕灰色、局部泛土黄；塔顶宝盖为绿色琉璃；基座灰砖、栏板灰白。

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the North Pagoda of Chaoyang (朝阳北塔), Liaoning, a SQUARE-plan brick pagoda with dense corbelled eaves, present Liao-dynasty appearance, drawn straight on from the south face as in Image 2 (2015 photo); Image 3 is a crop of the same photo's eaves for counting only. From bottom to top: a square brick pedestal with a band of imitation balustrade panels and a short central stair; a tall square first storey whose front face carries, in relief, one seated Buddha with a round halo in the centre, a standing bodhisattva on each side, a small pagoda-shaped relief at each outer edge, and a row of flying apsaras above; a ring of brick bracket-sets at the top of the storey carrying the broad first eave; above it EXACTLY TWELVE more corbelled eaves, each narrower than the one below, so that the tower has THIRTEEN eaves in total (count them: 1 broad bracketed eave + 12); then a flat top with a low green-glazed dome-shaped cap and a thin mast. The eaves taper evenly toward the top. Remove the modern railings, lamp posts, paving, people, guy-wires and the sky. Portrait 1024×1536, whole pagoda from pedestal foot to mast about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins.
Orientation: portrait 1024×1536.
